span.p:
Partner_CTF.exe connects to
\\.\pipe\FlareChallenge and reads
11 bytes -> RC4 key 'HarryPotter'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VirtualProtect(strlen, 0x17, RWX)
movups xmm6, [strlen] —
save the original 23 bytes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
overwrite strlen with a 23-byte stub:
it always returns 0x13, and rewrites
its argument in place as
c = ((c + position) & 0xFF) ^ 0x13

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
call strlen on the data string:
'Bxs]bv`^u)TpcnolVjN' becomes
'Piertotum Locomotor'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
restore the saved 23 bytes — the hook
is gone before anything else calls strlen

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
standard RC4 KSA with key 'HarryPotter',
then a modified PRGA:
i += 18 instead of i += 1

span.p:
step 18 = len('Wingardium Leviosa'),
the other spell stored beside it
